about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-context.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

why matched.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched.reply: You were matched because you share interests in live music and gigs, and you both enjoy cinema for your weekends. The app also matched you because they have the laid-back style you asked for.

how often.reply: You asked to meet every two weeks. You can check your mentor's details and how to get in touch on the [[Your Mentor]] page.

checklist.reply: You have two items left on your checklist: to join a society and to find a dentist. You can check them off and view them anytime on your [[Checklist]] page.

who is my mentor.reply: Your mentor's name and how to get in touch are listed on the [[Your Mentor]] page.

course society.ask: Can you suggest a society for my course?
course society.reply: Since you study English Literature, you might like the [[English]] society. Have you had a chance to look at your [[Checklist]] yet?

why matched, waiting.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, waiting.reply: Your mentor is being chosen by hand by our mentoring coordinator, and we will let you know as soon as they find the right match for you.

why matched, no mentor.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, no mentor.reply: You haven't been matched with a mentor yet, but you can easily ask for one over on the [[Find a mentor]] page.
